messages.subject: warnings from calculateDiffMeth function
parts:
Hi altuna,

While running the calculateDiffMeth function for my RRBS data, I repeatedly get warnings "glm.fit: fitted probabilities numerically 0 or 1 occurred"

Does it mean any quality issue in the data or just some statistical issue inherent to the RRBS type data?

Does it make sense to proceed further given these warnings?

Regards,
Kalyan

messages.author: 38c56d0e82a34280
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] warnings from calculateDiffMeth function
parts:
It's not a problem. This can occurs at loci where the methylation of each group are in disjoint ranges- for example all treatment 0 samples have methylation from 0-15, and all treatment 1 samples have methylation between 65-85. This is called "complete separation" and will give p-values of 0, and the warnings you see. The smaller your sample size, the more likely it is to have sites where this happens.

Dhruva
